title: Awareness is a higher-order state in a generative model of perception

statements.text: In Fleming's higher-order state space model, awareness reports are metacognitive inferences about a generative model of perceptual content. The awareness state is simple and abstract, a probability that some content is present, and asymmetric: many perceptual states sit under present, few under absent.
statements.scope: Fleming's allied model. Fleming calls its reading as a theory of awareness itself, rather than of awareness reports, the stronger reading.

sources.quote: I propose a computational framework that characterises awareness reports as metacognitive decisions (inference) about a generative model of perceptual content
Awareness is a higher-order state in a generative model of perceptual contents.
